head: Crimean Bridge partly collapses after Ukrainian strikes
sub: Zelensky calls it an unprecedented operation weeks in the making. The Kremlin says it will rebuild the bridge.

head: Iran fires drones at Bahrain after US strikes on Qeshm
sub: Bahrain says it stopped the drones. The IRGC says it targeted a US radar; the US says nothing was damaged.

head: Israeli settlers kill a Palestinian woman, 72, near Jericho
sub: Ten others were wounded, the Palestinian health ministry says. Israel's army says the settlers fired after being attacked.

head: Trump announces critical-minerals deals at the Quad summit in Manila
sub: He says they will prevent 'coercion by any single foreign supplier'. Modi, Takaichi and Albanese also attended.

head: US loses its measles elimination status after 26 years
sub: The Pan American Health Organization also strips Mexico and Bolivia. The US has had about 5,400 cases and 10 deaths this year.

head: Democrat Mary Peltola wins the Alaska Senate race
sub: She defeats Republican Dan Sullivan two weeks after the 3 November vote; Democrats reach 56 Senate seats.

head: China and Canada expand tariff relief after Carney meets Xi
sub: China cuts tariffs on Canadian pork and seafood; Canada extends exemptions for Chinese steel and aluminium.

head: Russian military plane crashes in Siberia, killing all 19 aboard
sub: The Defence Ministry says preliminary findings point to equipment failure.

head: Bangladesh garment workers clash with police over wages
sub: Thousands demand a monthly minimum of 30,000 taka ($240) and block highways; at least 37 factories close.

head: Mongolia's president announces his resignation
sub: He quit three days after a former Ulaanbaatar mayor accused him of embezzlement; parliament must accept it.

head: Haitians march in support of Salvadoran anti-gang troops
sub: Demonstrators rally in several cities. El Salvador says the troops will leave once kidnapped technicians are rescued.

head: Mozambique's opposition leader goes on trial over 2024 protests
sub: He arrived at the Supreme Court over his alleged role in deadly protests after the disputed election.
